title: ctx package manifest
description: manifest.json at the root of a ctx package. Unknown top-level fields are allowed and preserved.

version.description: Exact semantic version (https://semver.org), without a leading 'v'.

type.description: Kind of context this package holds, for example 'project' or 'discipline'. Fixed for the lifetime of a package name.

dependencies.description: Package name to semver range: *, an exact version, ^ and ~ ranges, wildcards (1.x) and comparators joined by spaces or commas. Alternatives (||) and hyphen ranges are not supported.

provides.description: Free-form description of what the package contributes; interpreted by consumers, not by ctx.

engines.description: Tool name to semver range the package requires.

provenance.description: Where and how the artifact was built.
